text:
mohit: hey team 👋 onboarding check: i can hit Datadog metrics but several Grafana dashboards 403 (esp. anything with traces). Sentry shows events but stack frames are collapsed. who should i ping for that?

devex-bot: Welcome Mohit! To request observability access run `open-access-request` or drop your @redwood email here and someone will help.

anya: welcome Mohit :tada: paste your work email and i'll add you to the `observability-viewers` group. quick FYI — some dashboards were moved when we switched to folder-based provisioning, so older links in the quickstart will 404/403.

mohit: mohit.kapoor@redwood.com — thanks. curious also about Sentry: there are many events but no full stack traces, only summaries. is that by design?

anya: yes by default prod Sentry scrubs sensitive params and collapses frames for privacy. for debugging you can request a short-lived elevated view (security reviews the request). we usually grant 1-3 hour sessions. file an access request and tag `security` + owning team.

ops-bot: Access request created: resource=Grafana:Dashboards/Observability, requester=mohit.kapoor@redwood.com, status=pending. Use `access status 1891234567` to track.

mohit: thanks. one more: i maintain an infra repo and was about to add a dashboard link to our README. should i link the panel iframe or use a snapshot?

anya: for docs/readme use Panel -> Share -> Snapshot -> External link (no auth). iframe embeds are internal-only and will 403 for folks outside our org. if you want an always-up-to-date internal dashboard link, include the panel link and note that viewers need `observability-viewers`.

mohit: helpful. any keyboard shortcuts in Grafana to jump around fast?

anya: yep — `g` then `d` opens dashboards, `/` searches, `t` toggles time picker, `s` shares the panel. Also the bottom-left help has the full list.

mohit: i noticed a few dashboards were auto-provisioned via our infra repo (grafana/provisioning/dashboards). is it safe to update those directly or should i open a PR?

anya: always open a PR against the infra repo. Provisioned dashboards are managed by the repo and direct edits in Grafana will be overwritten by the provisioning agent. if you need a temporary tweak, take a snapshot or create a new copies folder and edit there.

ops-bot: Access update: Grafana viewer role granted for mohit.kapoor@redwood.com; Sentry pending.

mohit: got Grafana access, can now view traces and the latency panels. Sentry invite arrived too — accepted and stack frames still collapsed but i filed the elevated access request per your note. thanks for the quick help!

anya: great — welcome aboard. if you want a 10-min walkthrough of the key dashboards and where we keep exported PNGs for docs, ping me and i'll demo later today.

mohit: would love that. 4pm my time works. thanks again :raised_hands:
